model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven evaluation criteria when assessing a system or interface, with the criteria listed along the vertical axis and the participant count shown on the horizontal axis ranging from 0 to 6. The bars are color-coded and sorted in descending order of participant count: “Relevant FCs” (dark purple) was selected by 6 participants, “FC Summary” (medium purple) by 5, “Relevance Explanation” (teal) and “Clarity and Simplicity” (green-teal) each by 3, “Overall Summary” (light green) by 2, and both “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” (light lime green) by 1 participant each. The chart visually emphasizes that “Relevant FCs” was the most frequently chosen criterion, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” were the least selected, with all values clearly labeled at the end of each bar for precise comparison.
